name: Snowflake (core platform)
sku: Snowflake Standard edition. Capability that needs the Enterprise edition is scored in the other Snowflake records with an enterprise-tier constraint.

store.warehouse.note: A cloud data platform with separate storage, compute and cloud-services layers. Virtual warehouses are the compute clusters that run SQL, and Snowflake tables are described as ideal for data warehouses.

serve.query-engine.note: A SQL query engine designed natively for the cloud, run on virtual warehouses.

transform.sql-transform.note: Dynamic tables turn a SELECT query into a table that Snowflake keeps up to date by refreshing only changed rows, and Snowflake infers the dependency graph between them from the SQL.

transform.code-transform.note: Snowpark provides Python, Java and Scala libraries whose DataFrame operations and UDFs run inside Snowflake, with no separate cluster.

store.table-format.note: Apache Iceberg tables keep data in storage you manage, with Snowflake or an external catalog as the catalog, ACID transactions and schema evolution. Available on all accounts, clouds and regions.

store.olap-serving.note: Interactive warehouses and interactive tables are built for sub-second responses and high concurrency, for real-time dashboards and data-powered APIs. Queries over 5 seconds fall back to a standard warehouse.

serve.semantic-layer.note: Semantic views store metrics, dimensions and relationships as database objects, queried with SQL, Cortex Analyst or BI tools. Querying them reached general availability in August 2025.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: Tasks run SQL or stored procedures on a fixed interval or a cron expression, on serverless or warehouse compute, with automatic retry.

orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: Tasks chain into task graphs that run in series or parallel. It orchestrates work inside Snowflake only.

orchestrate.event-triggers.note: A task can be triggered when new data arrives in a stream instead of on a clock.

orchestrate.ci-cd.note: DCM Projects give declarative object management with plan-then-deploy validation and multi-environment targeting, and the Snowflake CLI has first-party integrations for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD and Azure DevOps.

bands.note: Budgets set a monthly credit limit on the whole account or on a custom group of objects or tagged resources, and notify by email, cloud messaging or webhook when spend is projected to exceed it. Usage data refreshes every 6.5 hours by default.
Alerts evaluate a condition on a schedule, or on newly inserted data, and then run an action such as sending a notification. They can watch credit usage or data that breaks a business rule.
A Terraform provider manages account-level objects, alongside DCM Projects for the objects inside databases. It provisions Snowflake objects, not the cloud beneath them.
DCM Projects target multiple environments from one declarative definition.

presentation.tagline: Cloud data platform: SQL warehouses, Snowpark, dynamic tables, tasks and Iceberg.
